title: Require Recipe Stage Authoring File Shape
forbids: recipe stage index modules that do not default-export one createStage authoring value or that mirror domain-operation input, output, config, or strategy internals
why: A recipe stage index.ts owns stage identity, authoring configuration, and step selection. Domain-operation internals remain behind public domain contracts, while filesystem topology and support-module names are owned separately by the recipe-stage structure rule.
remediate: Default-export the stage's createStage value, compose public domain and local step surfaces, and remove direct access to operation input, output, config, or strategy internals.
message: Recipe stage index.ts must be the positive createStage authoring owner.
